KJV verses for peace when your mind runs

Peace is not pretending everything is fine. Peace is where your mind rests while life is still hard.

Isaiah 26:3 (KJV): "Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee."

John 14:27 (KJV): "Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you... Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid."

Psalm 94:19 (KJV): "In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul."

One next step: Choose one verse above, write it once by hand, and carry it through the day.
